nodes.label: deportes.jpg — Sports Equipment Hero Image
nodes.description: Promotional/hero image showing a collection of sports balls and equipment arranged together on a white background. Visible items: orange basketball, blue-and-yellow volleyball, brown American football, black-and-white soccer ball (fútbol), yellow-green tennis balls with a tennis racket, and a baseball with a wooden bat. Purpose: system asset for the DeporteParaTodos Angular frontend to visually represent the multi-sport platform concept. Used as a generic sports/athletics illustration (e.g., home page banner, category header, or placeholder image for sports categories).
nodes.design_purpose: Hero / decorative image representing multi-sport activities for the DeporteParaTodos sports management application
